clarification: Follow the user instruction to edit the highest scored model under the same completed evaluation conditions. Coding is the stated primary objective.
next_edit_base: Whichever completed comparable model has the highest official equal-source code score; exact coding tie uses official overall score. Never use a partial result for this choice.
mixed_tradeoff: If F06 achieves a higher complete code score but loses substantially elsewhere, preserve that coding gain by editing F06 next to repair the losses. Do not revert the editing base to a lower coding score merely to simplify the method. This does not mean those losses are accepted as a finished model.
teacher_is_not_edit_base: A separately declared frozen teacher checkpoint may preserve an earlier mode/behavior while only the highest-code editing base receives new weights. Both identities and all new training/model calls must be recorded. No baseline WSP rerun.
final_acceptance: Full other-domain losses still require explicit assessment and correction when the complete tradeoff is not beneficial; final60/test and DeepSWE gates remain. No publication or90-point claim without measured support.
